title: Molecular recognition and induced dimerization of hnRNP A2/B1 truncations by G-quadruplex single strand DNA.
authors: Shahatibieke, Dilidaer; Tang, Xiaohui; Zheng, Xuanfang; Liu, Yue; Abula, Abudoureyimu
one_liner_zh: 该文结合SEC/ITC/CD/AUC及NPDock模拟，研究hnRNP A2/B1截短体与G4结构ssDNA的结合及诱导二聚化，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且含结构建模，但非典型TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移。
abstract: Heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein A2/B1 (hnRNP A2/B1) is a multifunctional nucleic acid metabolism regulator with established roles in viral infection and tumorigenesis. However, a critical gap exists between the oligomeric state of hnRNP A2/B1 and its function as a nuclear DNA sensor. To address this gap, we generated full-length hnRNP A2/B1 and three domain-truncated variants ( big up tri, openNLS, RRM-PrLD, RRM-RGG) using SUMO/MBP fusion expression systems. To define the nucleic acid binding and oligomeric properties of these variants, we combined SEC with EMSA and ITC. These analyses revealed that full-length hnRNP A2/B1 forms soluble amorphous aggregates, whereas the truncated variants exist as stable homogeneous monomers under in vitro solution conditions. Additionally, results demonstrated that the RRM-RGG (15-250) variant binds to ssDNA but not dsDNA. Notably, SEC combined with CD and AUC confirmed that RRM-RGG (15-250) truncations undergo homodimerization induced by 12nt and 22nt Guanine quadruplex (G4) structure enriched ssDNA, which is abundant in the genomes of diverse viruses. Structure predictions revealed that the C-terminal PrLD, and NLS domain are intrinsically disordered, a feature potentially underlying the protein's aggregation propensity and crystallization recalcitrance. NPDock simulations demonstrated that G4-structured ssDNA binds and stabilizes the RRM-RGG (15-250) truncation via non-conserved key residues that are distinct from those of other hnRNP family members. This work provides a biophysical basis for hypothesizing that G4-structured ssDNA-dependent dimerization may contribute to the protein's antiviral function, and establishes a biophysical framework to guide future investigations into the protein's antiviral mechanism and the design of rational targeted inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 异质性核糖核蛋白A2/B1（hnRNP A2/B1）是一种多功能核酸代谢调节因子，在病毒感染和肿瘤发生中具有明确作用。然而，hnRNP A2/B1的寡聚状态与其作为核DNA传感器功能之间存在关键空白。为解决这一问题，我们利用SUMO/MBP融合表达系统生成了全长hnRNP A2/B1及三个结构域截短变体（big up tri、openNLS、RRM-PrLD、RRM-RGG）。为确定这些变体的核酸结合和寡聚特性，我们将SEC与EMSA和ITC相结合。这些分析揭示，全长hnRNP A2/B1形成可溶性无定形聚集体，而截短变体在体外溶液条件下以稳定的均一单体形式存在。此外，结果表明RRM-RGG（15-250）变体结合ssDNA但不结合dsDNA。值得注意的是，SEC结合CD和AUC证实，RRM-RGG（15-250）截短体在富含12nt和22nt鸟嘌呤四链体（G4）结构的ssDNA诱导下发生同源二聚化，而这种ssDNA在多种病毒基因组中含量丰富。结构预测显示，C端PrLD和NLS结构域本质上是无序的，这一特征可能构成该蛋白聚集倾向和结晶困难的基础。NPDock模拟表明，G4结构ssDNA通过非保守关键残基结合并稳定RRM-RGG（15-250）截短体，这些残基与其他hnRNP家族成员不同。本研究为以下假设提供了生物物理基础：G4结构ssDNA依赖性二聚化可能有助于该蛋白的抗病毒功能，并建立了指导未来研究该蛋白抗病毒机制及设计合理靶向抑制剂的生物物理框架。
